text:
Who Is Milind Chandwani? Balika Vadhu Actress Avika Gor’s Fiance
Milind Chandwani rose to prominence after participating in MTV Roadies Real Heroes in 2019.
Avika Gor and Milind Chandwani are officially engaged. The actress shared the news by sharing beautiful photos from the ceremony held on June 11. The couple, who have been in a relationship for several years, were flooded with love and congratulatory messages from fans and friends the moment the news went public.
While Avika has been in the spotlight since childhood, many are curious to know more about Milind. Milind Chandwani is an IIM-Ahmedabad graduate and the founder of Camp Diaries, an NGO focused on empowering underprivileged children. He began his professional journey at Infosys after completing his MBA and later gained public attention through his appearance on MTV Roadies: Real Heroes in 2019, where he was part of Neha Dhupia’s gang.

Avika Gor opened up about her relationship with Milind Chandwani on Bharti Singh’s podcast. The couple first met through mutual friends in Hyderabad, but Milind admitted that he friend-zoned her for the first six months of knowing each other.
She said, “I started liking him since day one. I was very sure about him. When you know, you know… Mere haath mein hota toh main saadhe chaar saal pehle shaadi kar chuki hoti. Kuch sochna nahin tha. Ab jo hai yahi hai. Mere dimaag mein toh ho chuki hai shaadi (It is what it is. There was no second thought about it. I am married to him in my mind)."
View this post on Instagram
Along with the pictures of her engagement, Avika wrote, “He asked.. I smiled, I cried (in that order )…and screamed the easiest YES of my life! I’m full filmy — background score, slow-mo dreams, mascara running and all. He’s logic, calm, and “let’s carry a first-aid kit just in case." I manifest drama. He manages it. And somehow, we just… Fit. So when he asked, the heroine in me took over — arms in the air, tears in my eyes, and zero network in my brain. Because real love? It may not always be perfect. But, It. Is. Magical."
Avika Gor rose to fame with her roles in hit television shows like Balika Vadhu and Sasural Simar Ka. In recent years, she has successfully expanded her career into regional cinema, showcasing her versatility as an actor.
